```yaml
name: GPU Reset

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: '3.8'
          activate-environment: true
          ignore-empty-workdir: false
          enable-cache: true
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          pytest test_all_gather_gluon.py
```
This GitHub Actions workflow file sets up a job named "build-and-test" that runs on every push and pull request to the "main" branch. It checks out the code, sets up Python 3.8, installs dependencies from a `requirements.txt` file, and then runs tests using `pytest`. The tests specifically focus on validating the correctness of the Gluon all-gather kernel implementation.
